concurrentWork: Other repository validation/build processes ran concurrently during early execution; CPU/wall metrics are not an isolated service-level benchmark. Process RSS excludes those processes.
measurementScope: Thirty-minute fixed-working-set local stress in one process, four opaque scopes, 20 fixed keys per scope, 64 offered storm callers per scope. Cache apply/refresh/TTL/invalidation and EventHub publish/subscribe only. EventReducer and handler hashes are provenance; their adapters are not executed by this workload. Actual wall duration and bounded 121 process/accounted-cache checkpoints establish measured scope only, no fleet or production throughput claim.

memoryObservations.interpretation: No sustained RSS/live-heap growth observed over this measured interval. The final five minutes have identical resident RSS at every checkpoint. Allocator/runtime pools, bounded checkpoint history and process infrastructure remain above cold start; cache accounting is separate and all owned cache/hub counters return to zero. Malloc gauges are snapshots, not an allocation trace or proof about unmeasured workloads.

peer: offline fixed-key cache/broadcast scripts; no credentials or sockets
provenanceNotes: Original sourceSHA256 and executableSHA256 identify the measurement build; finalSourceSHA256 records final review comparison without rewriting that history. Source drift is explicitly classified below. Permissions, reducer, handlers, Client facade and real shard/network execution are outside this cache/broadcast workload. No final-binary or fleet capacity claim is inferred.
